title: Dominion Invaders
game_overview: Take the captain chair on the starship bridge to allocate reactor power, calibrate shields, fire Phasers and Quantum torpedos, and navigate hostile Dominion War sectors.
winning_condition: Successfully navigate through 5 hostile Dominion War sectors and neutralize the flagship threat.
losing_condition: Starship hull integrity reaches 0% or reactor sustains critical meltdown.

controls.action: Select and interact with bridge consoles (Weapons, Shields, Engines, Sensors, Repair).

controls.input: Number Keys 1-4 / Q, W, E, R
controls.action: Quick-switch active station console or trigger station emergency overdrive.
Steer ship trajectory, adjust sublight thrusters, and aim tactical weapon reticle.
Fire tactical battery or initiate emergency warp evasive maneuver.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Command Presence: The player experiences the tension of commanding an advanced starship through interactive bridge consoles and an expansive forward viewport. 2. Tactical Energy Distribution: Balancing reactor power between Shields, Weapons, Engines, and Life Support under fire. 3. Emergent Crisis Management: System breaches, hull fires, and electronic warfare force immediate tactical triage.
sections.summary: Tactical Multitasking, Diegetic Bridge Immersion, and Escalating Crisis Management.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The captain scans sector anomalies on the navigation view, engages hostile interceptors and cosmic debris fields, directs subsystem power in real-time, dispatches automated repair drones to compromised bridge conduits, and activates the warp drive to enter next sector.
sections.summary: Sector Scan -> Alert Station -> Engage Threats & Hazards -> Repair & Upgrade -> Warp.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Power Grid Distribution: Direct energy units between Kinetic Cannons, Deflector Shields, Sublight Thrusters, and Sensor Arrays. 2. Viewport Tactical Reticle: Aim and lock photon torpedoes and phase lasers at oncoming raiders and asteroids seen through the main forward viewport. 3. Subsystem Damage Control: Extinguish electrical conduit overloads and reboot offline telemetry nodes during red alert status.
sections.summary: Reactor Power Allocation, Viewport Combat Targeting, and Station Diagnostics.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Forward-facing 2D perspective (simulated 2.5D space vectoring through forward viewport). Asset Orientation Baseline: Hostile vessels, asteroids, and spatial anomalies fly towards the viewport or cross horizontally across the tactical screen. Controls: Responsive helm steering and target lock. Camera: Fixed bridge view with dynamic camera shake on hull impacts.
sections.summary: First-person Bridge Cockpit View with dynamic starfield motion.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer 1 (Deep Space Background): Desaturated starfields, distant nebulae, and stellar phenomena. Layer 2 (Space Action / Viewport): High-contrast enemy ships, laser bolts, and meteor hazards. Layer 3 (Foreground Bridge Console): Diegetic glowing holographic displays, neon status meters, and tactical alert lights.
sections.summary: Distinct background nebula, mid-ground viewport threats, and crisp foreground interactive bridge consoles.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: 1. Bridge Captain & Crew Officers (Helm, Tactical, Engineering). 2. Swarm Interceptors: Agile small raiders making high-speed strafing runs. 3. Void Dreadnought: Heavy boss vessel equipped with particle beam cannons and point defense turrets. 4. Plasma Coronal Ejections: Environmental hazards requiring shield modulation.
sections.summary: Bridge Crew Personnel, Rogue Starfighter Drones, Heavy Void Frigates, and Cosmic Anomalies.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: 360-degree mini-radar sweeps identify approaching threats 4 seconds before visual entry. Red proximity warnings alert the player to imminent torpedo impacts, giving time to trigger shield deflection.
sections.summary: Tactical Sensor Radar, Incoming Missile Warning HUD, and Emergency Shield Boost.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Torpedo lock reticle tightens and chirps rhythmically before launch. State Change Juice: Bridge lighting dynamically transitions from soft blue cruising illumination to pulsing amber yellow-alert and strobe red-alert. Impact Juice: Screen shake, spark bursts from consoles, and deep resonant bass explosions when enemy warships detonate.
sections.summary: Holographic interface glows, hull impact alarms, screen tremors, and warp streaks.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed for players who love tactical command simulations, space exploration, and crisis management. High-score leaderboards rank captains by sectors cleared, efficiency, and minimal hull damage.
sections.summary: Sci-Fi strategy and arcade simulation fans seeking immersive spaceship command.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Subsystem status icons use both distinct color coding and geometric symbols (triangle for shields, diamond for weapons, circle for engines). Includes key remapping and auto-fire targeting toggle.
sections.summary: Colorblind-friendly UI modes, adjustable combat speed, and fully scalable touch controls.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Persistent campaign progress, ship upgrade terminal between sectors, sector jump map, and instantaneous restart capability.
sections.summary: Title Screen -> Station Tutorial -> Sector Campaign -> Victory / Defeat Recap.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Render on-screen virtual steering buttons and station shortcut triggers in the bottom corners when mobile viewport is detected. Direct pointer-events-auto applied strictly to interactive touch widgets with touch-none CSS class.
sections.summary: Custom mobile on-screen tactical control overlay.
